notes.title: Update Notes for patch 1.0.10
notes.notes: Once again, thanks to your feedback, we fixed a bunch of typos that slipped into the texts in various parts of the game and added some missing descriptions.

notes.title: Update Notes for patch 1.0.9
notes.notes: Thank you very much to everyone who sent us feedback on the game. Thanks to you, we fixed many typos in the texts that escaped our attention despite intensive testing. In addition, we made slight adjustments to some images so they better fit into the overall scene.
